I need some water.|Boba Fett warns the Tusken child|audio=FettWater.flac|}} A [[Tusken Raider]] [[Gender|male]] '''youngling''' was part of a [[Unidentified Tusken Raider tribe|tribe]] of Tuskens that was active in the [[Dune Sea]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. While the fallen [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] was held [[prisoner]] by the tribe, the [[Youngling|child]] watched over the man and beat him when they first met. When Fett attempted to escape the [[Tusken Raider camp (Boba Fett)|tribe's camp]], the young Tusken tried to stop him to no avail, and the older Tuskens recaptured the prisoner instead. Later, the Tusken youngling and his pet [[Unidentified massiff|massiff]] took Fett and a [[Unidentified Rodian prisoner|Rodian prisoner]] on a trip into the dunes, where they observed the [[Kintan Striders Gang]] attacking a [[Unidentified moisture farm (Tatooine)|moisture farm]]. The child then forced his two prisoners to dig for [[black melon]]s. However, a [[sand beast]] attacked the group and [[Death|killed]] the [[Rodian]]. During the fight, the youngling found himself fleeing from his adversary before Fett was able to kill the beast himself. Fett was thus accepted into the tribe and went on to teach the Tuskens various skills to fight against the [[Skirmish in the Dune Sea|intruding]] [[Pyke Syndicate]]. Sometime afterward, following Fett's vision quest, the youngling alerted the tribe to the man's return and watched his exchange with the Tusken [[Tusken Chieftain|chieftain]] and another [[Tusken warrior]]. The child soon guided Fett to a nearby Tusken workshop, where the former bounty hunter crafted his own [[gaderffii stick]]. When Fett subsequently visited the [[Pyke Boss|boss]] of the Pyke Syndicate's Tatooine assets, the syndicate [[Massacre of a Tusken Raider tribe|massacred]] the Tusken tribe. Upon discovering that the tribe had been destroyed, Fett [[Cremation|cremated]] their bodies and burned the child's small gaderffii stick. ==Biography== ===Child of the sand=== {{Quote|Uh, what do you want me to do?''"
[Youngling speaks in Tusken]
"''Dig?|Boba Fett and the Tusken child|audio=FettDig.flac|}} [[File:Bobatrip.png|thumb|left|300px|Boba Fett stumbling while the youngling leads him and the Rodian]] A [[Tusken Raider]] [[Gender|male]] [[Youngling|child]] lived as part of a [[Unidentified Tusken Raider tribe|Tusken Raider tribe]] in the [[Dune Sea]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].{{Film|VI}} Around [[4 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' after the famed [[bounty hunter]]{{Databank|boba-fett|Boba Fett}} [[Boba Fett]] was captured by Tuskens following his [[Rescue of Han Solo|defeat]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]], the child, along with several other Tusken children, inspected the bound Fett before beating the [[prisoner]] with sticks. That [[Standard day|night]], the tied-up Fett was left by a [[fire]]place, guarded by the youngling's pet [[Unidentified massiff|massiff]]. The youngling himself stood sentry nearby. When Fett freed himself from his bonds, a [[Unidentified Rodian prisoner|Rodian prisoner]] tied up beside Fett alerted the tribe, and the child ran at the escaped captive with his stick, letting out a cry. Fett knocked down the Tusken child and took his stick, refraining from beating the startled Tusken before running from the [[Tusken Raider camp (Boba Fett)|camp]] as other Tuskens arrived, having been alerted by the youngling's cries. The Tusken Raiders were able to quickly recapture Fett. The next morning, the child woke up Fett, untying him and the Rodian. He led the prisoners and the [[massiff]] across the dunes of Tatooine, tugging Fett as he stumbled to the ground due to how weak he had become. The group reached a [[Unidentified moisture farm (Tatooine)|moisture farm]],{{BOBF|Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land}} {{AD|Disney+}} which they found under raid from a group of [[Nikto]] [[Speeder bike|speed bikers]], the [[Kintan Striders Gang]].{{Databank|kintan-striders-gang|Kintan Striders Gang}} The child therefore turned his group around and led them to a separate location to dig for [[black melon]]s. [[File:Sadistic_Tusken_Youngling.png|thumb|right|300px|The youngling poured out the milk from Fett's black melon.]] Once at the location, the Tusken youngling ordered Fett and the Rodian prisoner to dig for the [[melon]]s. The Rodian complied immediately, although Fett had trouble understanding the Tusken's orders. After realizing what the child wanted, Fett proceeded to dig under the watchful [[eye]]s of the Tusken and the massiff. When Fett attempted to drink from one of the melons, the young Tusken angrily lashed his stick at the man, who caught it and insisted he needed to drink. Taking the black melon from his prisoner, the youngling proceeded to dump the melon's [[milk]] out for his massiff. Later, as the child [[Sleep|slept]] next to the massiff, he was awoken when the group was attacked by a [[sand beast]]{{Databank|tatooine-sand-beast|Tatooine sand beast}} that the Rodian prisoner had unburied. The Tusken stared in shock as the sand beast targeted the Rodian before launching the massiff over the youngling's head after the smaller creature attacked it. While the sand beast [[Death|killed]] the Rodian and held up Fett, the Tusken child attempted to fight the creature by stabbing it in the foot with his small [[gaderffii stick]], but the creature struck him and threw him back. The sand beast was thus fixated on the youngling, who frantically fled as the creature made chase. However, Fett pursued the beast and used his chains to strangle the creature to death. Seeing the creature dead, the youngling shouted in excitement. The Tusken child, Fett, and the massiff returned to the camp with the youngling carrying the severed head of the creature that had attacked them as a trophy, shouting excitedly. He took the trophy to the older Tuskens, who gathered around him as the child acted out the fight. The adult Tuskens congratulated the child with cheers and congratulatory pats. ===Train spotting=== {{Quote|When train comes, need you to help signal with this.|Fett, to the youngling|{{BOBF|Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine}}}} [[File:ChildMirror.png|thumb|left|300px|Fett teaching the child to signal with a mirror]] Fett was accepted by the tribe and started living among them. Meanwhile, the Tuskens came into conflict with a [[Tatooine repulsor train|repulsor train]] operated by the [[Pyke Syndicate]] by around [[5 ABY]], which [[Skirmish in the Dune Sea|fired]] on the tribe while traveling through the Dune Sea. Fett constructed a plan to stop the train that involved him teaching the members of the tribe various skills such as speeder bike riding. He also taught the child to use a [[mirror]] to reflect the sunlight from Tatooine's two [[Star|suns]]''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' as a signal to the rest of the tribe when the train approached. The tribe later went to dig for more black melons in the dunes when the Pyke repulsor train returned. Alerted to the train's approach, the child began running toward his designated position atop one of the larger dunes. Running across the dunes, he used his mirror to signal more Tuskens who had been positioned further along the train's route to take the Pykes by surprise. Fett and a band of Tuskens were able to [[Raid on a Pyke repulsortrain|stop]] the repulsor train and send its Pyke personnel back to their superiors with a warning. ===Fett's integration=== {{Quote|He used to live among a Tusken Raider tribe in the desert.''"
"''They no longer exist.''"
"''Are you sure?''"
"''Yes. We destroyed them ourselves.|Mok Shaiz and the Pyke boss discuss the destruction of the youngling's tribe|{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}}}} [[File:BobaReturnsFromVisionQuest-BoBFCh2.png|thumb|right|300px|The youngling watches as Fett brings the wortwood branch to the Tusken chief and warrior.]] Later on, the Tusken chieftain sent Fett on a vision quest, leading him to a [[wortwood tree]]. The next day, the youngling was sitting with his massiff, cracking the contents of some nuts into a bucket when the massiff alerted him to a new arrival. The youngling realized that it was Fett, carrying a large branch taken from the wortwood [[tree]]. He alerted the rest of the tribe to Fett's arrival before rushing to Fett himself and jumping excitedly. The youngling stayed and watched Fett exchange with the [[Tusken Chieftain|chieftain]] of the tribe and a [[Tusken warrior]] before being led into one of the tribe's tents. When Fett came back out, the youngling, being gestured over by the chieftain, led the man across the dunes to a workshop at a wreck site, where a [[Unidentified Tusken Raider craftsman|Tusken craftsman]] helped Fett make a gaderffii stick from the wortwood branch. Sometime after, Fett left the camp on a [[Boba Fett's bantha|bantha]] to negotiate protection fees with the Pyke Syndicate's [[Pyke Boss|boss]] on Tatooine. The Tusken youngling watched Fett leave the camp for the Pyke's [[Desert Survey Office|headquarters]] at the [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]], the man nodding at the child as he left. However, while Fett was away,{{BOBF|Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa}} the Pyke boss sent his forces to destroy the Tusken tribe. The Pykes [[Massacre of a Tusken Raider tribe|massacred]] the Tuskens, including the youngling, and left behind the emblem of the Kintan Striders to frame them. After Fett returned, he [[Cremation|cremated]] and mourned the fallen Tuskens and burned the youngling's small gaderffii stick in a fire. Fett later enacted his [[Attack on the Kintan Striders|revenge]] on the Kintan Striders{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}} in [[9 ABY]], believing them to be behind the massacre, but he eventually came to learn that it was in fact the Pykes who were responsible. Fett ultimately fought and defeated the syndicate in a [[Battle of Mos Espa|battle]], which forced the Pykes to abandon Tatooine altogether. ==Personality and traits== [[File:Childwithhead.png|thumb|left|200px|The youngling carrying the sand creature's head in triumph]] The youngling was at times sadistic, beating Fett when he was a defenseless prisoner and pouring the contents of a black melon on ground for his massiff instead of letting Fett quench his thirst. When Fett drank water from a black melon, the youngling became aggressive and attempted to beat the human with his stick. When the sand beast attacked the child and his prisoners, the child was shocked by the creature and froze but went on to attack the beast when it lashed at the youngling's massiff. However, after Fett defeated the Tatooine sand beast and the child returned with its head, he retold the story to the other Tuskens triumphantly. After Fett had been accepted by the tribe, the child became excited whenever he returned to the camp, in one instance jumping with excitement when Fett returned from his vision quest. The Tusken youngling spoke in [[Tusken]]. ==Equipment== [[File:WortwoodTreeWood-SW100Objects.png|thumb||right|250px|The small wortwood gaderffii stick used by the youngling]] The youngling wore dark [[Color|brown]] [[robe]]s that covered his torso and a tan headwrap that covered his face. He also wore tan gloves, dark brown pants, and a tube-like accessory around his neck. On his chest, he wore a red pouch and a dirty white towel. The youngling used a small gaderffii stick similar in nature to the larger ones used by the adult Tuskens. During the attack on the Pyke Syndicate's repulsortrain, he utilized a small mirror to make signals to other Tuskens by reflecting sunlight. ==Behind the scenes== The Tusken Raider child first appeared in the flashbacks of "[[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land]]," the premiere episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', which was released on [[December 29]], [[2021]].{{DisneyPlusYouTube|t9Ca4ARSfqA|Next On Disney+ | December 2021}} The child was portrayed by [[Wesley Kimmel]]. The [[2023]] [[The Book of Boba Fett Junior Novel|junior novelization]] of ''The Book of Boba Fett'' by [[Joe Schreiber]] adapted lines from the show, presenting some of them differently.
